title: Repair public active-countdown gesture dispatch across Main Display surfaces

gates.name: Host gesture and lifecycle regression suite

verify: Before changing production behavior, obtain fresh task-scoped RED for the existing downstream protected-cancellation regression guard (REQ-013; regression guard only; canonical basis in normative_inputs): with a countdown active, two public taps at a 120 ms interval leave the countdown active at approximately the 350 ms checkpoint. The W11 semantic-fail artifacts ground the defect but do not replace current-attempt RED or make this guard a W12 acceptance locator.

Implement the smallest Main Display-local repair: one shared active-countdown touch dispatcher captures the public surface and event stream at ACTION_DOWN while the timer is active, routes the accepted single/double/hold intents, and continues delivery through ACTION_UP or ACTION_CANCEL without rechecking live TimerLifecycleState for the captured stream. Share this path across the root/background, weather cards, city and active preset surfaces; retain city long-hold -> Settings, idle selected-city short-tap no-op, empty-city short-tap -> Settings, idle preset start and the existing overdue any-tap path. Do not move timer semantics or state ownership out of Timer & Alert.

Add focused host support for the dispatcher stream lifetime and surface routing. It must distinguish non-city single/double, city hold/double and preset active-tap delivery, prove terminal-event delivery after the timer command changes state, and retain existing TimerCapability checks for protected single tap, cancellation and overdue dismissal. Host output is supporting evidence only and MUST NOT be presented as proof of Android View dispatch or touch reachability.

Run the clean build, complete host unit suite and static diff gate. Preserve existing four-card/main-shell, preset, city-routing and overdue behavior; no timer arithmetic, persistence, lifecycle state-machine or Settings semantic change is in scope.

On the exact authorized generic AVD Tecno_Pova_6_API_35, confirm generic Google Android 15/API35 x86_64 identity, install the current APK, and use only public UI/probe routes with synthetic or redacted state. Execute all mandatory public scenarios: (1) selected-city 800 ms hold during countdown opens Settings and system Back returns to the still-active countdown; (2) selected-city double tap at 120 ms cancels and remains on Main Display beyond the 600 ms long-press timeout with no delayed Settings; (3) non-city weather-card single tap keeps countdown active and shows the accepted hint; (4) non-city weather-card double tap at 120 ms cancels to idle by the approximately 350 ms checkpoint; (5) public preset taps retain idle start, active single-tap protection and active double-tap cancellation. Record visible four-card/preset composition as a guard, not a new layout claim.

Use the existing public overdue setup when safely reachable to confirm any-tap dismissal remains intact; otherwise retain the existing TimerCapability host proof as a regression guard and do not re-own Timer & Alert semantics. Finish with the documented safe cleanup: no credentials or private storage/state access, verifier temporaries removed, normal MainActivity focused, timer idle, Settings absent, emulator awake.

Keep Samsung GT-I9300I Android 11 custom-ROM and 1280x720 physical-target geometry, readability, system-bar and lifecycle/audio behavior DEFERRED. Generic-emulator evidence MUST NOT be promoted to Samsung, custom-ROM, 1280x720 or physical-device PASS.

Stop and route to /spec-design if the repair requires a new module, graph edge, public contract, owner, event/message boundary or Planning Revision change; stop and return to /feature-to-tasks FT-001 if accepted behavior, tier, dependency or material scope must change. Do not reopen or rewrite TASK-003 or TASK-014 and do not mutate scheduler checkpoint or terminal state.
evidence_required: [REQ-013 regression guard only; canonical basis in normative_inputs] Expected RED: the current public non-city weather-card double tap at a 120 ms interval leaves an active countdown visible at approximately 350 ms. GREEN: the same public route returns to idle by the decisive checkpoint, while a single tap keeps countdown active and shows the accepted hint; the pass/fail comparison is distinguished for single and double regression checks. Artifact: focused host dispatcher evidence plus fresh generic-emulator public screenshots/hierarchy notes; host evidence is explicitly supporting and the runtime artifact is decisive for Android touch reachability. This is not a W12 acceptance locator.

[FT-001-AC-005 / REQ-004 task-owned acceptance delta] Expected: the existing city hold/short-tap routes remain unchanged after dispatcher unification, city double cancellation has no delayed Settings navigation, and the selected-city hold -> Settings -> system Back path remains public and reachable. Artifact: the mandatory generic-emulator interaction matrix and host routing output, with no host-only reachability claim.

[Runtime safety and cleanup] Expected: the public scenarios use only synthetic/redacted state, leave no credential or private-state evidence, and end in normal MainActivity with timer idle and Settings absent. Artifact: redacted runtime log/checklist and final safe-state observation.
purpose: Implement the bounded FT-001-AC-005 Main Display city hold/Settings-preservation delta by making active-countdown event delivery coherent inside the existing Main Display owner, while exercising the existing downstream protected-cancellation contract (REQ-013; regression guard only; canonical basis in normative_inputs) and preserving the W11 city/layout outcome and all existing capability boundaries.
success_outcome: A fresh build and host evidence support one Main Display-local active-countdown dispatch stream, and the exact generic Android runtime proves the task-owned FT-001-AC-005 city hold/Settings-preservation route remains reachable without delayed navigation after city double, while non-city single/double cancellation checks exercise the existing downstream protected-cancellation contract as regression guards only; preset interactions and overdue dismissal remain intact, and no new module, edge, public contract or timer semantic owner is introduced.
anti_goals: Do not reopen, rewrite, normalize or replace TASK-003-T3-FT-001-W2 or TASK-014-T3-FT-001-W11, their lifecycle/status, accepted evidence or scheduler history.
Do not weaken or narrow the REQ-013 rule that a double tap anywhere during countdown cancels; do not make a weather-card-only exception.

Do not reimplement Timer & Alert arithmetic, persistence, lifecycle transitions, overdue semantics or private-state access; submit only the existing public gesture commands and render existing projections.
Do not change Settings semantics, the selected-city/empty-city rules, preset meaning, overdue behavior, forecast behavior or the accepted four-card shell.
Do not add a module, graph edge, event/message infrastructure, public contract, dependency, architecture owner, product control or new test/runtime boundary.
Do not claim Samsung GT-I9300I Android 11 custom-ROM or 1280x720 physical-device PASS from the generic emulator.

forbidden_scope: TASK-003-T3-FT-001-W2 and TASK-014-T3-FT-001-W11 identity, lifecycle, evidence and protocol history
.protocols/AUTONOMOUS-RUN/status.md and all scheduler checkpoint or terminal-state fields
Timer & Alert state ownership, timer arithmetic, persistence, lifecycle transitions and overdue semantics
Settings & Location, Weather Context or Forecast Sessions private state/storage and any direct cross-slice write
new Android event/message boundary, module, graph edge, public contract or dependency
Samsung/custom-ROM/1280x720 PASS claims, live API keys and secret-bearing logs, screenshots or evidence
stop_conditions: Stop and route to /spec-design if a coherent dispatcher cannot remain inside Main Display or requires a new module, graph edge, public contract, owner or Planning Revision change.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-001 if execution exposes a different accepted behavior, AC ownership, tier, dependency or material scope.
Stop without a GREEN reachability claim if the exact generic emulator identity, public event result or decisive checkpoints cannot be observed safely; do not substitute host-only evidence.
Stop before any private-state mutation, credential-bearing setup or scheduler/protocol terminal-state write.

constraints: Main Display remains the primary owner of composition and gesture intent; it calls Timer & Alert and Settings & Location only through the existing public contracts.

Capture the active-countdown public stream at ACTION_DOWN and deliver its terminal events without live-state rechecking; the dispatcher is an internal Main Display mechanism and not a new public contract.

Preserve the accepted city long-hold -> Settings, empty-city short-tap -> Settings and selected-city short-tap no-op rules outside the active countdown, plus the active city hold and delayed-navigation protection already evidenced by W11.

Exercise the existing downstream protected-cancellation contract (REQ-013; regression guard only; canonical basis in normative_inputs): a single tap during countdown keeps the timer active and shows the accepted hint; a double tap anywhere cancels it.
Keep preset start/single/double behavior and overdue any-tap dismissal as regression guards; Timer & Alert remains the only state/lifecycle owner.
Use the authorized generic emulator only for public Android dispatch evidence; Samsung GT-I9300I Android 11 custom-ROM and 1280x720 release evidence remains deferred.
Do not add dependencies, private storage access, credentials, event/message infrastructure or business orchestration in MainActivity, generic utilities or the composition root.
verification_targets: Existing downstream protected-cancellation contract (REQ-013; regression guard only; canonical basis in normative_inputs): the public non-city weather-card double tap cancels an active countdown, while the corresponding single tap preserves countdown and shows the hint; Timer & Alert semantics are consumed, not reimplemented.

FT-001-AC-005 / REQ-004 task-owned Main Display acceptance delta: selected-city hold during countdown reaches Settings and system Back returns; selected-city short tap remains a no-op and empty-city short tap remains an accepted Settings entry. This does not reopen or rewrite TASK-014's failed historical layout/reachability record.
Main Display → Timer & Alert and Main Display → Settings & Location exact contracts: no owner, edge, Settings state, timer state owner or public contract changes.

Focused host stream proof: active capture is decided at ACTION_DOWN, all events through ACTION_UP/ACTION_CANCEL reach the captured dispatcher after timer state changes, and surface routing distinguishes city hold from timer single/double commands. This is supporting evidence only.

Mandatory generic-emulator public runtime matrix on Tecno_Pova_6_API_35: city hold, city double with delayed-Settings checkpoint, non-city single with hint, non-city double cancellation, public preset interactions, visible shell/preset guards and safe cleanup each have distinguishable results.
Existing overdue any-tap dismissal remains green as a regression guard without changing Timer & Alert semantics or claiming a new FT-006 timer outcome.
.memory-bank/testing/runtime-verification.md#target-device-evidence: Samsung/custom-ROM/1280x720 behavior remains DEFERRED with residual risk and no promoted runtime PASS.
